notes: Exact npm registry metadata existence and tagged upstream docs are reference evidence, not a source-exact project migration.
No codemod described here was executed or version-pinned as a standalone released executable unless independently shown; user project gates remain necessary.
Every applicability condition is scoped to matching recipient code and exact version/peer constraints; missing pins and coverage are UNKNOWN.
Production v2 requires separately trusted-main reviewed source-exact positive and negative fixture receipts, deduplication, schema, provenance and protected signing.

sourceBackedBehavior: The v9 guide documents removal of experimentalFeatures.charts in favor of chartsIntegration on DataGridPremium.
The v9 guide documents a filterPanelColumns to filterPanelColumn locale-text key change and further behavior/DOM changes.
The pinned target peer range excludes MUI Material and System v5/v6, and requires v7.3+ or v9 as listed.
applicability: A project explicitly upgrades the MUI Data Grid 8 to 9 line and uses supported peers.
Inspect DataGridPremium charts experimental flag, locale overrides and DOM/keyboard tests before proposing changes.
Check exactly installed React, Material and System providers and lockfile; do not broaden held declarations.
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Strict target frozen install with compatible MUI Material and System positive and held-v6 negative peer-resolution cases.
Grid navigation, sorting/filtering, locale label and DOM role controls in an isolated UI fixture.

scopeLimits: Only the documented experimentalFeatures charts flag; do not claim coverage of every migration change.

sourceBackedBehavior: Version 7.0.0 requires Vite 8 and Svelte >=5.46.4, while version 6.0.0 accepts Vite 6.3/7 and Svelte 5.
The 7.0.0 official changelog removes deprecated vitePlugin.hot and ignorePluginPreprocessors options; it directs hot configuration to compilerOptions.hmr.
The public vite-plugin-svelte API idFilter is replaced by filter; third-party integrations with plugin.api.sveltePreprocess require separate review.
applicability: Direct Svelte/Vite plugin upgrades from exact 6.0.0 to 7.0.0; check Vite/Svelte graph before upgrading.
Only mention config/plugin API rewrites when the source uses the deprecated options or plugin API.
Run pinned Node, Vite and Svelte installation and actual SFC/HMR SSR acceptance on a representative recipient.
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Vite 7 held-negative peer gate and Vite 8 positive resolution control.
Svelte 5.45 negative vs 5.46.4 positive peer gate, and plugin API code-use AST inspection.
SFC compile/HMR and SSR tests after any plugin option/API update.

manifestEvidence.taggedManifestVersionBoth: 0.0.1 (monorepo build sentinel; do not treat as npm dist version)

sourceBackedBehavior: Tag 23.0.0 migration registry documents an automatic safety net moving @nx/vite:test to @nx/vitest:test when Vitest is present.
The same tagged migrations registry conditions Vitest 4 migrations on vitest >=4.0.0 and Vite 8 rollupOptions rename on vite >=8.0.0.
Tagged Nx source manifest expands the Vite peer to include Vite 8 but no longer lists the old Vitest peer; do not infer published npm peers from monorepo source manifest.
applicability: Requires an Nx workspace with @nx/vite test executor or Vite plugin Vitest inference; skip migrations for workspaces without Vitest.
Check selected Vite and Vitest versions separately. Rename rollupOptions only for matching Vite 8 configs, including nested environments; inspect helper modules manually.
Do not treat generator suggestions as evidence that affected project builds/tests pass.
controlsRecommendedNotRun: Nx 22 baseline /23 migration CLI dry run with a frozen public fixture and nx.json/project.json target diff.
Positive direct @nx/vitest executor and negative held @nx/vite:test route; Vitest 4 config tests and Vite 8 manualChunks semantics.
Pinned public npm package versions/peers and lockfile installation, not only monorepo tag manifests.
